name: Path
overview: Scripture reveals that the path a person walks reflects their spiritual condition and relationship with God. The psalmist prays for God to show His ways and teach His paths, emphasizing the need for divine guidance (Psalms 25:4). God's word serves as a lamp and light to direct the believer's steps along the path of life, which leads to joy and eternal pleasures (Psalms 119:105; Psalms 16:11). Walking away from the counsel of the ungodly and choosing the good path of righteousness and judgment leads to blessing and equity (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 2:9).
